name: food-eat-heal
comment: WP-2.6. ItemFood / ItemSoup.onItemRightClick, reached through use_item when nothing is placed (sendPlaceBlock on the stone floor: Item.onItemUse is false; then sendUseItem). The player (id 0) at (0.5, 61, 0.5) holds an apple (hotbar 0), mushroom stew (1), 8 cookies (2, ItemCookie), a golden apple (3) and a cooked porkchop (4). t 2: hurt by 8 (attack op, no attacker): health 12. t 4: the apple heals 4 (EntityLiving.heal resets heartsLife to 10) and the emptied stack leaves the slot. t 6: the stew heals 10 (capped at 20) and is replaced by a bowl. t 30: hurt by 15. t 32-33: two cookies heal 1 each (stack 8 -> 6). t 35: the golden apple heals 42, capped at 20. t 37: the porkchop at full health is eaten anyway. t 39: an empty hand does nothing.
